# Ardent Research Solutions (ARS)

> Ardent Research Solutions (Pvt.) Ltd. is a research and advisory company providing independent research, policy analysis and strategic intelligence to businesses, institutions and decision makers in Pakistan.

## Corporate information

- Registered as Ardent Research Solutions (Private) Limited, CUIN 0352535, incorporated 25 August 2026 at Islamabad under the Companies Act, 2017 (verify: https://leap.secp.gov.pk/#/verify-company-info/0352535)
- [Corporate Information](https://arspakistan.pk/corporate/): legal name, company type, registered office, directors and contact details
- [Registration & Compliance](https://arspakistan.pk/corporate/registration/): registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission of Pakistan (SECP) under the Companies Act, 2017
- [Certificate of Incorporation](https://arspakistan.pk/corporate/registration/certificate/): copy of the company's SECP Certificate of Incorporation

## Organisation

- [About ARS](https://arspakistan.pk/about.html): founder, directors and mission
- [Advisory Board](https://arspakistan.pk/advisory-board/)
- [Contact](https://arspakistan.pk/contact/): office address, phone and enquiry form
- Contact: info@arspakistan.pk

## Research areas

- [Research Areas](https://arspakistan.pk/research/): the six areas ARS works in
- [Economy & Public Policy](https://arspakistan.pk/research/economy-public-policy/): macroeconomy, fiscal and monetary policy, taxation, debt, inflation, trade and employment
- [Business, Industry & Markets](https://arspakistan.pk/research/business-industry-markets/): industry, SMEs, investment, trade, competitiveness, consumer markets and financial services
- [Governance & Institutions](https://arspakistan.pk/research/governance-institutions/): government performance, regulation, public sector reform, accountability and institutions
- [Society & Human Development](https://arspakistan.pk/research/society-human-development/): education, health, employment, demographics, poverty, inequality and social mobility
- [Cities, Infrastructure & Climate](https://arspakistan.pk/research/cities-infrastructure-climate/): urbanisation, housing, transport, energy, water, infrastructure and climate change
- [Technology & Digital Economy](https://arspakistan.pk/research/technology-digital-economy/): AI, fintech, digitalisation, digital economy and technology policy
